sentences.en: Let me congratulate you on your victory in the tournament.
sentences.zh: 让我祝贺你在锦标赛中的胜利。

sentences.en: The Party won a sweeping victory at the general election.
sentences.zh: 该党在大选中赢得了压倒性的胜利。

sentences.en: The victory was won at the cost of many lives.
sentences.zh: 这场胜利是以许多生命的代价换来的。
